verses.sanskrit:
मुण्डकोपनिषत्
ॐ भद्रं कर्णेभिः श्रुणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः ।
स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवाꣳसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः ।
स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः ।
स्वस्ति नस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु।
॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
verses.roman:
Muṇḍakopaniṣat
oṃ bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śruṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ .
sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāgͫsastanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ .
svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ .
svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu.
.. oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ..
verses.colloquial:
mundakopanishat ..
om bhadram karnebhih shrunuyaama devaa bhadram pashyemaakshabhiryajatraah .
sthirairangaistushtuvaagͫsastanuubhirvyashema devahitam yadaayuh .
svasti na indro vriddhashravaah svasti nah puushaa vishvavedaah .
svasti nastaarkshyo arishtanemih svasti no brihaspatirdadhaatu.
.. om shaantih shaantih shaantih ..
verses.translation_reworded:
Om. O gods, may our ears hear what is auspicious! O worshipful gods, may our eyes see what is good! Strong in limb and body, may we sing your praise and enjoy the life Prajapati has allotted to us!

Om. Peace! Peace! Peace!

verses.sanskrit:
ॐ ब्रह्मा देवानां प्रथमः सम्बभूव विश्वस्य कर्ता
भुवनस्य गोप्ता । स ब्रह्मविद्यां सर्वविद्याप्रतिष्ठामथर्वाय
ज्येष्ठपुत्राय प्राह ॥ १॥
verses.roman:
oṃ brahmā devānāṃ prathamaḥ sambabhūva viśvasya kartā
bhuvanasya goptā . sa brahmavidyāṃ sarvavidyāpratiṣṭhāmatharvāya
jyeṣṭhaputrāya prāha .. 1..
verses.colloquial:
om brahmaa devaanaam prathamah sambabhuuva vishvasya kartaa
bhuvanasya goptaa . sa brahmavidyaam sarvavidyaapratishthaamatharvaaya
jyeshthaputraaya praaha .. 1..
verses.translation_reworded: Om. Brahma, Maker of the universe and Preserver of the world, was first among the devas. To Atharva, His eldest son, He taught the Knowledge of Brahman, on which all knowledge rests.

verses.sanskrit:
अथर्वणे यां प्रवदेत ब्रह्माऽथर्वा तं
पुरोवाचाङ्गिरे ब्रह्मविद्याम् ।
स भारद्वाजाय सत्यवाहाय प्राह
भारद्वाजोऽङ्गिरसे परावराम् ॥ २॥
verses.roman:
atharvaṇe yāṃ pravadeta brahmā'tharvā taṃ
purovācāṅgire brahmavidyām .
sa bhāradvājāya satyavāhāya prāha
bhāradvājo'ṅgirase parāvarām .. 2..
verses.colloquial:
atharvane yaam pravadeta brahmaa'tharvaa tam
purovaachaangire brahmavidyaam .
sa bhaaradvaajaaya satyavaahaaya praaha
bhaaradvaajo'ngirase paraavaraam .. 2..
verses.translation_reworded: In ancient times Atharva passed on to Angir the Knowledge of Brahman that Brahma had taught him. Angir gave it to Satyavaha of the clan of Bharadvaja, and he in turn handed it down to Angiras.

verses.sanskrit:
शौनको ह वै महाशालोऽङ्गिरसं विधिवदुपसन्नः पप्रच्छ ।
कस्मिन्नु भगवो विज्ञाते सर्वमिदं विज्ञातं भवतीति ॥ ३॥
verses.roman:
śaunako ha vai mahāśālo'ṅgirasaṃ vidhivadupasannaḥ papraccha .
kasminnu bhagavo vijñāte sarvamidaṃ vijñātaṃ bhavatīti .. 3..
verses.colloquial:
shaunako ha vai mahaashaalo'ngirasam vidhivadupasannah papraccha .
kasminnu bhagavo vijnaate sarvamidam vijnaatam bhavatiiti .. 3..
verses.translation_reworded: Saunaka, the great householder, came to Angiras in the proper way and asked: Revered sir, what is that which, once known, makes all this known?

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मै स होवाच ।
द्वे विद्ये वेदितव्ये इति ह स्म
यद्ब्रह्मविदो वदन्ति परा चैवापरा च ॥ ४॥
verses.roman:
tasmai sa hovāca .
dve vidye veditavye iti ha sma
yadbrahmavido vadanti parā caivāparā ca .. 4..
verses.colloquial:
tasmai sa hovaacha .
dve vidye veditavye iti ha sma
yadbrahmavido vadanti paraa chaivaaparaa cha .. 4..
verses.translation_reworded: Angiras replied: The knowers of Brahman tell us that two kinds of knowledge must be known, the Higher Knowledge and the lower knowledge.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रापरा ऋग्वेदो यजुर्वेदः सामवेदोऽथर्ववेदः
शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छन्दो ज्योतिषमिति ।
अथ परा यया तदक्षरमधिगम्यते ॥ ५॥
verses.roman:
tatrāparā ṛgvedo yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo'tharvavedaḥ
śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chando jyotiṣamiti .
atha parā yayā tadakṣaramadhigamyate .. 5..
verses.colloquial:
tatraaparaa rigvedo yajurvedah saamavedo'tharvavedah
shikshaa kalpo vyaakaranam niruktam chando jyotishamiti .
atha paraa yayaa tadaksharamadhigamyate .. 5..
verses.translation_reworded: The lower knowledge consists of the Rig-Veda, the Yagur-Veda, the Sama-Veda, the Atharva-Veda, siksha (phonetics), kalpa (rituals), vyakaranam (grammar), nirukta (etymology), chhandas (metre), and jyotis (astronomy). The Higher Knowledge is that by which the Imperishable Brahman is reached.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्तदद्रेश्यमग्राह्यमगोत्रमवर्ण-
मचक्षुःश्रोत्रं तदपाणिपादम् ।
नित्यं विभुं सर्वगतं सुसूक्ष्मं
तदव्ययं यद्भूतयोनिं परिपश्यन्ति धीराः ॥ ६॥
verses.roman:
yattadadreśyamagrāhyamagotramavarṇa-
macakṣuḥśrotraṃ tadapāṇipādam .
nityaṃ vibhuṃ sarvagataṃ susūkṣmaṃ
tadavyayaṃ yadbhūtayoniṃ paripaśyanti dhīrāḥ .. 6..
verses.colloquial:
yattadadreshyamagraahyamagotramavarna-
machakshuhshrotram tadapaanipaadam .
nityam vibhum sarvagatam susuukshmam
tadavyayam yadbhuutayonim paripashyanti dhiiraah .. 6..
verses.translation_reworded: Through the Higher Knowledge the wise see Brahman everywhere. Apart from it, Brahman cannot be seen or grasped. It has no root and no attributes, no eyes or ears, no hands or feet. It is eternal, omnipresent, all-pervading, and extremely subtle. It is imperishable and the source of all beings.

verses.sanskrit:
यथोर्णनाभिः सृजते गृह्णते च
यथा पृथिव्यामोषधयः सम्भवन्ति ।
यथा सतः पुरुषात् केशलोमानि
तथाऽक्षरात् सम्भवतीह विश्वम् ॥ ७॥
verses.roman:
yathorṇanābhiḥ sṛjate gṛhṇate ca
yathā pṛthivyāmoṣadhayaḥ sambhavanti .
yathā sataḥ puruṣāt keśalomāni
tathā'kṣarāt sambhavatīha viśvam .. 7..
verses.colloquial:
yathornanaabhih srijate grihnate cha
yathaa prithivyaamoshadhayah sambhavanti .
yathaa satah purushaat keshalomaani
tathaa'ksharaat sambhavatiiha vishvam .. 7..
verses.translation_reworded: A spider spins out its thread and draws it back in; plants spring up from the earth; hair grows on the head and body of a living man. In the same way everything in the universe comes forth from the Imperishable.

verses.sanskrit:
तपसा चीयते ब्रह्म ततोऽन्नमभिजायते ।
अन्नात् प्राणो मनः सत्यं लोकाः कर्मसु चामृतम् ॥ ८॥
verses.roman:
tapasā cīyate brahma tato'nnamabhijāyate .
annāt prāṇo manaḥ satyaṃ lokāḥ karmasu cāmṛtam .. 8..
verses.colloquial:
tapasaa chiiyate brahma tato'nnamabhijaayate .
annaat praano manah satyam lokaah karmasu chaamritam .. 8..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman expands through austerity, and from It primal matter is produced. From matter comes Prana; from Prana, mind; from mind, the elements; from the elements, the worlds; from these, works; and from works, their immortal fruits.

verses.sanskrit:
यः सर्वज्ञः सर्वविद्यस्य ज्ञानमयं तापः ।
तस्मादेतद्ब्रह्म नाम रूपमन्नं च जायाते ॥ ९॥
॥ इति मुण्डकोपनिषदि प्रथममुण्डके प्रथमः खण्डः ॥
verses.roman:
yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavidyasya jñānamayaṃ tāpaḥ .
tasmādetadbrahma nāma rūpamannaṃ ca jāyāte .. 9..
.. iti muṇḍakopaniṣadi prathamamuṇḍake prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ..
verses.colloquial:
yah sarvajnah sarvavidyasya jnaanamayam taapah .
tasmaadetadbrahma naama ruupamannam cha jaayaate .. 9..
.. iti mundakopanishadi prathamamundake prathamah khandah ..
verses.translation_reworded: He knows all and understands everything, and His austerity is made of knowledge. From Him, the Imperishable Brahman, are born Brahma, name, form, and food.

verses.sanskrit:
तदेतत् सत्यं मन्त्रेषु कर्माणि कवयो
यान्यपश्यंस्तानि त्रेतायां बहुधा सन्ततानि ।
तान्याचरथ नियतं सत्यकामा एष वः
पन्थाः सुकृतस्य लोके ॥ १॥
verses.roman:
tadetat satyaṃ mantreṣu karmāṇi kavayo
yānyapaśyaṃstāni tretāyāṃ bahudhā santatāni .
tānyācaratha niyataṃ satyakāmā eṣa vaḥ
panthāḥ sukṛtasya loke .. 1..
verses.colloquial:
tadetat satyam mantreshu karmaani kavayo
yaanyapashyamstaani tretaayaam bahudhaa santataani .
taanyaacharatha niyatam satyakaamaa esha vah
panthaah sukritasya loke .. 1..
verses.translation_reworded: This is the Truth: The sacrificial works revealed to the rishis in the hymns are described in many ways in the three Vedas. Practise them if you wish to gain their true results. This is your path to the fruits of your works.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा लेलायते ह्यर्चिः समिद्धे हव्यवाहने ।
तदाऽऽज्यभागावन्तरेणाऽऽहुतीः प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ २॥
verses.roman:
yadā lelāyate hyarciḥ samiddhe havyavāhane .
tadā''jyabhāgāvantareṇā''hutīḥ pratipādayet .. 2..
verses.colloquial:
yadaa lelaayate hyarchih samiddhe havyavaahane .
tadaa''jyabhaagaavantarenaa''hutiih pratipaadayet .. 2..
verses.translation_reworded: When the fire is well lit and its flames are flickering, a person should make the oblations in the space between the two portions of melted butter.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्याग्निहोत्रमदर्शमपौर्णमास-
मचातुर्मास्यमनाग्रयणमतिथिवर्जितं च ।
अहुतमवैश्वदेवमविधिना हुत-
मासप्तमांस्तस्य लोकान् हिनस्ति ॥ ३॥
verses.roman:
yasyāgnihotramadarśamapaurṇamāsa-
macāturmāsyamanāgrayaṇamatithivarjitaṃ ca .
ahutamavaiśvadevamavidhinā huta-
māsaptamāṃstasya lokān hinasti .. 3..
verses.colloquial:
yasyaagnihotramadarshamapaurnamaasa-
machaaturmaasyamanaagrayanamatithivarjitam cha .
ahutamavaishvadevamavidhinaa huta-
maasaptamaamstasya lokaan hinasti .. 3..
verses.translation_reworded: Suppose someone's Agnihotra sacrifice lacks the Darsa and Paurnamasa sacrifices, the Four Months' sacrifice, and the Autumnal sacrifice; or it goes without hospitality to guests; or the oblations are not offered at the right time; or it lacks the Vaisvadeva ceremony or is improperly done. Then it destroys that person's seven worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
काली कराली च मनोजवा च
सुलोहिता या च सुधूम्रवर्णा ।
स्फुलिङ्गिनी विश्वरुची च देवी
लेलायमाना इति सप्त जिह्वाः ॥ ४॥
verses.roman:
kālī karālī ca manojavā ca
sulohitā yā ca sudhūmravarṇā .
sphuliṅginī viśvarucī ca devī
lelāyamānā iti sapta jihvāḥ .. 4..
verses.colloquial:
kaalii karaalii cha manojavaa cha
sulohitaa yaa cha sudhuumravarnaa .
sphulinginii vishvaruchii cha devii
lelaayamaanaa iti sapta jihvaah .. 4..
verses.translation_reworded: Kali (the Black), Karali (the Terrific), Manojava (Swift as thought), Sulohita (the Very red), Sudhumravarna (colour of bright smoke; purple), Splulingini (the Scintillating), and the luminous Visvaruchi (the All-gleaming, all-formed): these seven, flickering about, are the seven tongues of the fire.

verses.sanskrit:
एतेषु यश्चरते भ्राजमानेषु यथाकालं
चाहुतयो ह्याददायन् ।
तं नयन्त्येताः सूर्यस्य रश्मयो यत्र
देवानां पतिरेकोऽधिवासः ॥ ५॥
verses.roman:
eteṣu yaścarate bhrājamāneṣu yathākālaṃ
cāhutayo hyādadāyan .
taṃ nayantyetāḥ sūryasya raśmayo yatra
devānāṃ patireko'dhivāsaḥ .. 5..
verses.colloquial:
eteshu yashcharate bhraajamaaneshu yathaakaalam
chaahutayo hyaadadaayan .
tam nayantyetaah suuryasya rashmayo yatra
devaanaam patireko'dhivaasah .. 5..
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever performs the sacrifices while these flames are shining, and offers oblations at the right time, is borne by those oblations on the rays of the sun to the place where the sole sovereign of the gods dwells.

verses.sanskrit:
एह्येहीति तमाहुतयः सुवर्चसः
सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्यजमानं वहन्ति ।
प्रियां वाचमभिवदन्त्योऽर्चयन्त्य
एष वः पुण्यः सुकृतो ब्रह्मलोकः ॥ ६॥
verses.roman:
ehyehīti tamāhutayaḥ suvarcasaḥ
sūryasya raśmibhiryajamānaṃ vahanti .
priyāṃ vācamabhivadantyo'rcayantya
eṣa vaḥ puṇyaḥ sukṛto brahmalokaḥ .. 6..
verses.colloquial:
ehyehiiti tamaahutayah suvarchasah
suuryasya rashmibhiryajamaanam vahanti .
priyaam vaachamabhivadantyo'rchayantya
esha vah punyah sukrito brahmalokah .. 6..
verses.translation_reworded: The shining oblations call to the sacrificer, "Come here! Come here!" They lead him along the rays of the sun, honouring him throughout and greeting him with pleasant words: "This is the holy heaven of Brahma, earned by your good deeds."

verses.sanskrit:
प्लवा ह्येते अदृढा यज्ञरूपा
अष्टादशोक्तमवरं येषु कर्म ।
एतच्छ्रेयो येऽभिनन्दन्ति मूढा
जरामृत्युं ते पुनरेवापि यन्ति ॥ ७॥
verses.roman:
plavā hyete adṛḍhā yajñarūpā
aṣṭādaśoktamavaraṃ yeṣu karma .
etacchreyo ye'bhinandanti mūḍhā
jarāmṛtyuṃ te punarevāpi yanti .. 7..
verses.colloquial:
plavaa hyete adridhaa yajnaruupaa
ashtaadashoktamavaram yeshu karma .
etacchreyo ye'bhinandanti muudhaa
jaraamrityum te punarevaapi yanti .. 7..
verses.translation_reworded: But those rafts of sacrifice are frail indeed, conducted by eighteen persons, on whom this inferior work depends; and so they can be destroyed. Fools who delight in them as the Highest Good fall prey to old age and death again and again.

verses.sanskrit:
अविद्यायामन्तरे वर्तमानाः
स्वयं धीराः पण्डितं मन्यमानाः ।
जङ्घन्यमानाः परियन्ति मूढा
अन्धेनैव नीयमाना यथान्धाः ॥ ८॥
verses.roman:
avidyāyāmantare vartamānāḥ
svayaṃ dhīrāḥ paṇḍitaṃ manyamānāḥ .
jaṅghanyamānāḥ pariyanti mūḍhā
andhenaiva nīyamānā yathāndhāḥ .. 8..
verses.colloquial:
avidyaayaamantare vartamaanaah
svayam dhiiraah panditam manyamaanaah .
janghanyamaanaah pariyanti muudhaa
andhenaiva niiyamaanaa yathaandhaah .. 8..
verses.translation_reworded: Fools who live in darkness, yet think themselves wise and are puffed up with empty scholarship, wander about, beset by many ills, like blind men led by the blind.

verses.sanskrit:
अविद्यायं बहुधा वर्तमाना वयं
कृतार्था इत्यभिमन्यन्ति बालाः ।
यत् कर्मिणो न प्रवेदयन्ति रागात्
तेनातुराः क्षीणलोकाश्च्यवन्ते ॥ ९॥
verses.roman:
avidyāyaṃ bahudhā vartamānā vayaṃ
kṛtārthā ityabhimanyanti bālāḥ .
yat karmiṇo na pravedayanti rāgāt
tenāturāḥ kṣīṇalokāścyavante .. 9..
verses.colloquial:
avidyaayam bahudhaa vartamaanaa vayam
kritaarthaa ityabhimanyanti baalaah .
yat karmino na pravedayanti raagaat
tenaaturaah kshiinalokaashchyavante .. 9..
verses.translation_reworded: Childish people, sunk in ignorance in many ways, congratulate themselves: "We have achieved life's purpose." Because their attachment keeps these performers of karma from knowing the Truth, they fall from heaven, stricken with misery, once the fruit of their work runs out.

verses.sanskrit:
इष्टापूर्तं मन्यमाना वरिष्ठं
नान्यच्छ्रेयो वेदयन्ते प्रमूढाः ।
नाकस्य पृष्ठे ते सुकृतेऽनुभूत्वेमं
लोकं हीनतरं वा विशन्ति ॥ १०॥
verses.roman:
iṣṭāpūrtaṃ manyamānā variṣṭhaṃ
nānyacchreyo vedayante pramūḍhāḥ .
nākasya pṛṣṭhe te sukṛte'nubhūtvemaṃ
lokaṃ hīnataraṃ vā viśanti .. 10..
verses.colloquial:
ishtaapuurtam manyamaanaa varishtham
naanyacchreyo vedayante pramuudhaah .
naakasya prishthe te sukrite'nubhuutvemam
lokam hiinataram vaa vishanti .. 10..
verses.translation_reworded: Ignorant fools, taking sacrifices and humanitarian works to be the highest, know of no higher good. After enjoying their reward on the heights of heaven, won by good works, they come back to this world or a lower one.

verses.sanskrit:
तपःश्रद्धे ये ह्युपवसन्त्यरण्ये
शान्ता विद्वांसो भैक्ष्यचर्यां चरन्तः ।
सूर्यद्वारेण ते विरजाः प्रयान्ति
यत्रामृतः स पुरुषो ह्यव्ययात्मा ॥ ११॥
verses.roman:
tapaḥśraddhe ye hyupavasantyaraṇye
śāntā vidvāṃso bhaikṣyacaryāṃ carantaḥ .
sūryadvāreṇa te virajāḥ prayānti
yatrāmṛtaḥ sa puruṣo hyavyayātmā .. 11..
verses.colloquial:
tapahshraddhe ye hyupavasantyaranye
shaantaa vidvaamso bhaikshyacharyaam charantah .
suuryadvaarena te virajaah prayaanti
yatraamritah sa purusho hyavyayaatmaa .. 11..
verses.translation_reworded: But there are wise people of tranquil mind who live in the forest on alms, practise the penances suited to their stations of life, and contemplate deities such as Hiranyagarbha. Freed from impurities, they depart by the Path of the Sun to the place where that immortal Person dwells, whose nature is imperishable.

verses.sanskrit:
परीक्ष्य लोकान् कर्मचितान् ब्राह्मणो
निर्वेदमायान्नास्त्यकृतः कृतेन ।
तद्विज्ञानार्थं स गुरुमेवाभिगच्छेत्
समित्पाणिः श्रोत्रियं ब्रह्मनिष्ठम् ॥ १२॥
verses.roman:
parīkṣya lokān karmacitān brāhmaṇo
nirvedamāyānnāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena .
tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchet
samitpāṇiḥ śrotriyaṃ brahmaniṣṭham .. 12..
verses.colloquial:
pariikshya lokaan karmachitaan braahmano
nirvedamaayaannaastyakritah kritena .
tadvijnaanaartham sa gurumevaabhigacchet
samitpaanih shrotriyam brahmanishtham .. 12..
verses.translation_reworded: Having examined all these worlds that works can gain, let a brahmin become free of desires, for nothing eternal can be produced by what is not eternal. To understand that Eternal, let him go, fuel in hand, to a guru who is well versed in the Vedas and always devoted to Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मै स विद्वानुपसन्नाय सम्यक्
प्रशान्तचित्ताय शमान्विताय ।
येनाक्षरं पुरुषं वेद सत्यं प्रोवाच
तां तत्त्वतो ब्रह्मविद्याम् ॥ १३॥
॥ इति मुण्डकोपनिषदि प्रथममुण्डके द्वितीयः खण्डः ॥
verses.roman:
tasmai sa vidvānupasannāya samyak
praśāntacittāya śamānvitāya .
yenākṣaraṃ puruṣaṃ veda satyaṃ provāca
tāṃ tattvato brahmavidyām .. 13..
.. iti muṇḍakopaniṣadi prathamamuṇḍake dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ..
verses.colloquial:
tasmai sa vidvaanupasannaaya samyak
prashaantachittaaya shamaanvitaaya .
yenaaksharam purusham veda satyam provaacha
taam tattvato brahmavidyaam .. 13..
.. iti mundakopanishadi prathamamundake dvitiiyah khandah ..
verses.translation_reworded: When a pupil has approached him in the proper way, with a mind fully serene and senses under control, the wise teacher should rightly impart to him the Knowledge of Brahman, through which one knows the immutable and true Purusha.

verses.sanskrit:
तदेतत् सत्यं
यथा सुदीप्तात् पावकाद्विस्फुलिङ्गाः
सहस्रशः प्रभवन्ते सरूपाः ।
तथाऽक्षराद्विविधाः सोम्य भावाः
प्रजायन्ते तत्र चैवापि यन्ति ॥ १॥
verses.roman:
tadetat satyaṃ
yathā sudīptāt pāvakādvisphuliṅgāḥ
sahasraśaḥ prabhavante sarūpāḥ .
tathā'kṣarādvividhāḥ somya bhāvāḥ
prajāyante tatra caivāpi yanti .. 1..
verses.colloquial:
tadetat satyam
yathaa sudiiptaat paavakaadvisphulingaah
sahasrashah prabhavante saruupaah .
tathaa'ksharaadvividhaah somya bhaavaah
prajaayante tatra chaivaapi yanti .. 1..
verses.translation_reworded: This is the Truth: Just as thousands of sparks, essentially one with the blazing fire, fly out from it, so, my good friend, various beings come forth from the imperishable Brahman and go back to Him again.

verses.sanskrit:
दिव्यो ह्यमूर्तः पुरुषः स बाह्याभ्यन्तरो ह्यजः ।
अप्राणो ह्यमनाः शुभ्रो ह्यक्षरात् परतः परः ॥ २॥
verses.roman:
divyo hyamūrtaḥ puruṣaḥ sa bāhyābhyantaro hyajaḥ .
aprāṇo hyamanāḥ śubhro hyakṣarāt parataḥ paraḥ .. 2..
verses.colloquial:
divyo hyamuurtah purushah sa baahyaabhyantaro hyajah .
apraano hyamanaah shubhro hyaksharaat paratah parah .. 2..
verses.translation_reworded: He is the self-luminous and formless Purusha, uncreated, existing both inside and outside. He has no prana and no mind; He is pure and higher than the supreme Imperishable.

verses.sanskrit:
एतस्माज्जायते प्राणो मनः सर्वेन्द्रियाणि च ।
खं वायुर्ज्योतिरापः पृथिवी विश्वस्य धारिणी ॥ ३॥
verses.roman:
etasmājjāyate prāṇo manaḥ sarvendriyāṇi ca .
khaṃ vāyurjyotirāpaḥ pṛthivī viśvasya dhāriṇī .. 3..
verses.colloquial:
etasmaajjaayate praano manah sarvendriyaani cha .
kham vaayurjyotiraapah prithivii vishvasya dhaarinii .. 3..
verses.translation_reworded: From Him are born prana, mind, all the sense-organs, Akasa, air, fire, water, and the earth that supports all.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्नीर्मूर्धा चक्षुषी चन्द्रसूर्यौ
दिशः श्रोत्रे वाग् विवृताश्च वेदाः ।
वायुः प्राणो हृदयं विश्वमस्य पद्भ्यां
पृथिवी ह्येष सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा ॥ ४॥
verses.roman:
agnīrmūrdhā cakṣuṣī candrasūryau
diśaḥ śrotre vāg vivṛtāśca vedāḥ .
vāyuḥ prāṇo hṛdayaṃ viśvamasya padbhyāṃ
pṛthivī hyeṣa sarvabhūtāntarātmā .. 4..
verses.colloquial:
agniirmuurdhaa chakshushii chandrasuuryau
dishah shrotre vaag vivritaashcha vedaah .
vaayuh praano hridayam vishvamasya padbhyaam
prithivii hyesha sarvabhuutaantaraatmaa .. 4..
verses.translation_reworded: The heavens are His head; the sun and moon, His eyes; the quarters, His ears; the revealed Vedas, His speech; the wind, His breath; the universe, His heart. The earth comes from His feet. He is indeed the inner Self of all beings.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मादग्निः समिधो यस्य सूर्यः
सोमात् पर्जन्य ओषधयः पृथिव्याम् ।
पुमान् रेतः सिञ्चति योषितायां
बह्वीः प्रजाः पुरुषात् सम्प्रसूताः ॥ ५॥
verses.roman:
tasmādagniḥ samidho yasya sūryaḥ
somāt parjanya oṣadhayaḥ pṛthivyām .
pumān retaḥ siñcati yoṣitāyāṃ
bahvīḥ prajāḥ puruṣāt samprasūtāḥ .. 5..
verses.colloquial:
tasmaadagnih samidho yasya suuryah
somaat parjanya oshadhayah prithivyaam .
pumaan retah sinchati yoshitaayaam
bahviih prajaah purushaat samprasuutaah .. 5..
verses.translation_reworded: The Fire whose fuel is the sun comes from Him. Rain comes from the moon, and the earth's herbs from rain. The herbs yield the seminal fluid that a man pours into a woman. Thus many living beings are born of the Purusha.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मादृचः साम यजूंषि दीक्षा
यज्ञाश्च सर्वे क्रतवो दक्षिणाश्च ।
संवत्सरश्च यजमानश्च लोकाः
सोमो यत्र पवते यत्र सूर्यः ॥ ६॥
verses.roman:
tasmādṛcaḥ sāma yajūṃṣi dīkṣā
yajñāśca sarve kratavo dakṣiṇāśca .
saṃvatsaraśca yajamānaśca lokāḥ
somo yatra pavate yatra sūryaḥ .. 6..
verses.colloquial:
tasmaadrichah saama yajuumshi diikshaa
yajnaashcha sarve kratavo dakshinaashcha .
samvatsarashcha yajamaanashcha lokaah
somo yatra pavate yatra suuryah .. 6..
verses.translation_reworded: From Him have come the Rik, the Saman, the Yajus, the Diksha, all sacrifices, the Kratus, gifts, the year, the sacrificer, and the worlds that the moon sanctifies and the sun lights up.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्माच्च देवा बहुधा सम्प्रसूताः
साध्या मनुष्याः पशवो वयांसि ।
प्राणापानौ व्रीहियवौ तपश्च
श्रद्धा सत्यं ब्रह्मचर्यं विधिश्च ॥ ७॥
verses.roman:
tasmācca devā bahudhā samprasūtāḥ
sādhyā manuṣyāḥ paśavo vayāṃsi .
prāṇāpānau vrīhiyavau tapaśca
śraddhā satyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vidhiśca .. 7..
verses.colloquial:
tasmaaccha devaa bahudhaa samprasuutaah
saadhyaa manushyaah pashavo vayaamsi .
praanaapaanau vriihiyavau tapashcha
shraddhaa satyam brahmacharyam vidhishcha .. 7..
verses.translation_reworded: He begets the various devas, the sadhyas, men, cattle, and birds, as well as prana and apana, rice and corn, penance, faith, truth, continence, and law.

verses.sanskrit:
सप्त प्राणाः प्रभवन्ति तस्मात्
सप्तार्चिषः समिधः सप्त होमाः ।
सप्त इमे लोका येषु चरन्ति प्राणा
गुहाशया निहिताः सप्त सप्त ॥ ८॥
verses.roman:
sapta prāṇāḥ prabhavanti tasmāt
saptārciṣaḥ samidhaḥ sapta homāḥ .
sapta ime lokā yeṣu caranti prāṇā
guhāśayā nihitāḥ sapta sapta .. 8..
verses.colloquial:
sapta praanaah prabhavanti tasmaat
saptaarchishah samidhah sapta homaah .
sapta ime lokaa yeshu charanti praanaa
guhaashayaa nihitaah sapta sapta .. 8..
verses.translation_reworded: From Him have sprung the seven pranas, the seven flames, the seven kinds of fuel, the seven oblations, and the seven planes where the pranas move, which lie in the cave and are seven in each living being.

verses.sanskrit:
अतः समुद्रा गिरयश्च सर्वेऽस्मात्
स्यन्दन्ते सिन्धवः सर्वरूपाः ।
अतश्च सर्वा ओषधयो रसश्च
येनैष भूतैस्तिष्ठते ह्यन्तरात्मा ॥ ९॥
verses.roman:
ataḥ samudrā girayaśca sarve'smāt
syandante sindhavaḥ sarvarūpāḥ .
ataśca sarvā oṣadhayo rasaśca
yenaiṣa bhūtaistiṣṭhate hyantarātmā .. 9..
verses.colloquial:
atah samudraa girayashcha sarve'smaat
syandante sindhavah sarvaruupaah .
atashcha sarvaa oshadhayo rasashcha
yenaisha bhuutaistishthate hyantaraatmaa .. 9..
verses.translation_reworded: From Him come all the oceans and mountains; from Him flow rivers of every kind; from Him too have come all plants and flavours, through which the inner self, surrounded by the elements, subsists.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरुष एवेदं विश्वं कर्म तपो ब्रह्म परामृतम् ।
एतद्यो वेद निहितं गुहायां
सोऽविद्याग्रन्थिं विकिरतीह सोम्य ॥ १०॥
॥ इति मुण्डकोपनिषदि द्वितीयमुण्डके प्रथमः खण्डः ॥
verses.roman:
puruṣa evedaṃ viśvaṃ karma tapo brahma parāmṛtam .
etadyo veda nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ
so'vidyāgranthiṃ vikiratīha somya .. 10..
.. iti muṇḍakopaniṣadi dvitīyamuṇḍake prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ..
verses.colloquial:
purusha evedam vishvam karma tapo brahma paraamritam .
etadyo veda nihitam guhaayaam
so'vidyaagranthim vikiratiiha somya .. 10..
.. iti mundakopanishadi dvitiiyamundake prathamah khandah ..
verses.translation_reworded: The Purusha alone is truly the universe, which is made up of work and austerity. My good friend, whoever knows this Brahman, the Supreme and Immortal, hidden in the cave of the heart, cuts through the knot of ignorance even here.

verses.sanskrit:
आविः संनिहितं गुहाचरं नाम
महत्पदमत्रैतत् समर्पितम् ।
एजत्प्राणन्निमिषच्च यदेतज्जानथ
सदसद्वरेण्यं परं विज्ञानाद्यद्वरिष्ठं प्रजानाम् ॥ १॥
verses.roman:
āviḥ saṃnihitaṃ guhācaraṃ nāma
mahatpadamatraitat samarpitam .
ejatprāṇannimiṣacca yadetajjānatha
sadasadvareṇyaṃ paraṃ vijñānādyadvariṣṭhaṃ prajānām .. 1..
verses.colloquial:
aavih samnihitam guhaacharam naama
mahatpadamatraitat samarpitam .
ejatpraanannimishaccha yadetajjaanatha
sadasadvarenyam param vijnaanaadyadvarishtham prajaanaam .. 1..
verses.translation_reworded: The Luminous Brahman lives in the cave of the heart and is known to move there. It is the great support of all, for everything that moves, breathes, and blinks is centred in It. Disciples, know That to be your Self: both gross and subtle, adorable, supreme, and beyond the understanding of creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
यदर्चिमद्यदणुभ्योऽणु च
यस्मिँल्लोका निहिता लोकिनश्च ।
तदेतदक्षरं ब्रह्म स प्राणस्तदु वाङ्मनः
तदेतत्सत्यं तदमृतं तद्वेद्धव्यं सोम्य विद्धि ॥ २॥
verses.roman:
yadarcimadyadaṇubhyo'ṇu ca
yasmim̐llokā nihitā lokinaśca .
tadetadakṣaraṃ brahma sa prāṇastadu vāṅmanaḥ
tadetatsatyaṃ tadamṛtaṃ tadveddhavyaṃ somya viddhi .. 2..
verses.colloquial:
yadarchimadyadanubhyo'nu cha
yasmim̐llokaa nihitaa lokinashcha .
tadetadaksharam brahma sa praanastadu vaanmanah
tadetatsatyam tadamritam tadveddhavyam somya viddhi .. 2..
verses.translation_reworded: That which is radiant and subtler than the subtle, by which all the worlds and those who live in them are supported, is truly the indestructible Brahman. It is prana, speech, and mind. It is the True and It is the Immortal. That alone is to be struck. Strike It, my good friend.

verses.sanskrit:
धनुर् गृहीत्वौपनिषदं महास्त्रं
शरं ह्युपासा निशितं सन्धयीत ।
आयम्य तद्भावगतेन चेतसा
लक्ष्यं तदेवाक्षरं सोम्य विद्धि ॥ ३॥
verses.roman:
dhanur gṛhītvaupaniṣadaṃ mahāstraṃ
śaraṃ hyupāsā niśitaṃ sandhayīta .
āyamya tadbhāvagatena cetasā
lakṣyaṃ tadevākṣaraṃ somya viddhi .. 3..
verses.colloquial:
dhanur grihiitvaupanishadam mahaastram
sharam hyupaasaa nishitam sandhayiita .
aayamya tadbhaavagatena chetasaa
lakshyam tadevaaksharam somya viddhi .. 3..
verses.translation_reworded: Take the Upanishad as the bow, the great weapon, and set on it the arrow sharpened by meditation. Then draw it back with a mind fixed on the thought of Brahman, and strike that mark, my good friend: the Imperishable.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रणवो धनुः शारो ह्यात्मा ब्रह्म तल्लक्ष्यमुच्यते ।
अप्रमत्तेन वेद्धव्यं शरवत् तन्मयो भवेत् ॥ ४॥
verses.roman:
praṇavo dhanuḥ śāro hyātmā brahma tallakṣyamucyate .
apramattena veddhavyaṃ śaravat tanmayo bhavet .. 4..
verses.colloquial:
pranavo dhanuh shaaro hyaatmaa brahma tallakshyamuchyate .
apramattena veddhavyam sharavat tanmayo bhavet .. 4..
verses.translation_reworded: Om is the bow, the atman is the arrow, and Brahman is said to be the mark. An undistracted mind must strike it. Then the atman becomes one with Brahman, as the arrow does with the target.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मिन् द्यौः पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षमोतं
मनः सह प्राणैश्च सर्वैः ।
तमेवैकं जानथ आत्मानमन्या वाचो
विमुञ्चथामृतस्यैष सेतुः ॥ ५॥
verses.roman:
yasmin dyauḥ pṛthivī cāntarikṣamotaṃ
manaḥ saha prāṇaiśca sarvaiḥ .
tamevaikaṃ jānatha ātmānamanyā vāco
vimuñcathāmṛtasyaiṣa setuḥ .. 5..
verses.colloquial:
yasmin dyauh prithivii chaantarikshamotam
manah saha praanaishcha sarvaih .
tamevaikam jaanatha aatmaanamanyaa vaacho
vimunchathaamritasyaisha setuh .. 5..
verses.translation_reworded: Heaven, earth, the space between, and the mind with all the sense-organs are woven in Him. Know that non-dual Atman alone and give up all other talk. He is the bridge to Immortality.

verses.sanskrit:
अरा इव रथनाभौ संहता यत्र नाड्यः ।
स एषोऽन्तश्चरते बहुधा जायमानः ।
ओमित्येवं ध्यायथ आत्मानं स्वस्ति वः
पाराय तमसः परस्तात् ॥ ६॥
verses.roman:
arā iva rathanābhau saṃhatā yatra nāḍyaḥ .
sa eṣo'ntaścarate bahudhā jāyamānaḥ .
omityevaṃ dhyāyatha ātmānaṃ svasti vaḥ
pārāya tamasaḥ parastāt .. 6..
verses.colloquial:
araa iva rathanaabhau samhataa yatra naadyah .
sa esho'ntashcharate bahudhaa jaayamaanah .
omityevam dhyaayatha aatmaanam svasti vah
paaraaya tamasah parastaat .. 6..
verses.translation_reworded: Within the heart, where the arteries meet like spokes fastened in the hub of a chariot wheel, He moves about, becoming many. Meditate on Atman as Om. Hail to you! May you cross beyond the sea of darkness!

verses.sanskrit:
यः सर्वज्ञः सर्वविद् यस्यैष महिमा भुवि ।
दिव्ये ब्रह्मपुरे ह्येष व्योम्न्यात्मा प्रतिष्ठितः ॥
मनोमयः प्राणशरीरनेता
प्रतिष्ठितोऽन्ने हृदयं सन्निधाय ।
तद् विज्ञानेन परिपश्यन्ति धीरा
आनन्दरूपममृतं यद् विभाति ॥ ७॥
verses.roman:
yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavid yasyaiṣa mahimā bhuvi .
divye brahmapure hyeṣa vyomnyātmā pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
manomayaḥ prāṇaśarīranetā
pratiṣṭhito'nne hṛdayaṃ sannidhāya .
tad vijñānena paripaśyanti dhīrā
ānandarūpamamṛtaṃ yad vibhāti .. 7..
verses.colloquial:
yah sarvajnah sarvavid yasyaisha mahimaa bhuvi .
divye brahmapure hyesha vyomnyaatmaa pratishthitah ..
manomayah praanashariiranetaa
pratishthito'nne hridayam sannidhaaya .
tad vijnaanena paripashyanti dhiiraa
aanandaruupamamritam yad vibhaati .. 7..
verses.translation_reworded: He knows all and understands all, and all the glory in the world is His. He, Atman, is placed in the space within the radiant abode of Brahman. He takes on the forms of the mind and guides the body and senses. He lives in the body, inside the heart. Through knowledge of That which shines as the blissful and immortal Atman, the wise see Him fully in all things.

verses.sanskrit:
भिद्यते हृदयग्रन्थिश्छिद्यन्ते सर्वसंशयाः ।
क्षीयन्ते चास्य कर्माणि तस्मिन् दृष्टे परावरे ॥ ८॥
verses.roman:
bhidyate hṛdayagranthiśchidyante sarvasaṃśayāḥ .
kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe parāvare .. 8..
verses.colloquial:
bhidyate hridayagranthishchidyante sarvasamshayaah .
kshiiyante chaasya karmaani tasmin drishte paraavare .. 8..
verses.translation_reworded: When He who is both high and low is seen, the fetters of the heart break, all doubts are settled, and all works stop bearing fruit.

verses.sanskrit:
हिरण्मये परे कोशे विरजं ब्रह्म निष्कलम् ।
तच्छुभ्रं ज्योतिषं ज्योतिस्तद् यदात्मविदो विदुः ॥ ९॥
verses.roman:
hiraṇmaye pare kośe virajaṃ brahma niṣkalam .
tacchubhraṃ jyotiṣaṃ jyotistad yadātmavido viduḥ .. 9..
verses.colloquial:
hiranmaye pare koshe virajam brahma nishkalam .
tacchubhram jyotisham jyotistad yadaatmavido viduh .. 9..
verses.translation_reworded: There, in the highest, golden sheath, the stainless and indivisible Brahman shines. It is pure. It is the Light of lights. It is what those who know the Self know.

verses.sanskrit:
न तत्र सूर्यो भाति न चन्द्रतारकं
नेमा विद्युतो भान्ति कुतोऽयमग्निः ।
तमेव भान्तमनुभाति सर्वं
तस्य भासा सर्वमिदं विभाति ॥ १०॥
verses.roman:
na tatra sūryo bhāti na candratārakaṃ
nemā vidyuto bhānti kuto'yamagniḥ .
tameva bhāntamanubhāti sarvaṃ
tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti .. 10..
verses.colloquial:
na tatra suuryo bhaati na chandrataarakam
nemaa vidyuto bhaanti kuto'yamagnih .
tameva bhaantamanubhaati sarvam
tasya bhaasaa sarvamidam vibhaati .. 10..
verses.translation_reworded: There the sun does not shine, nor the moon and stars, nor these lightnings, let alone this fire. When He shines, everything shines after Him; by His light everything is lit.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मैवेदममृतं पुरस्ताद् ब्रह्म पश्चाद् ब्रह्म दक्षिणतश्चोत्तरेण ।
अधश्चोर्ध्वं च प्रसृतं ब्रह्मैवेदं विश्वमिदं वरिष्ठम् ॥ ११॥
॥ इति मुण्डकोपनिषदि द्वितीयमुण्डके द्वितीयः खण्डः ॥
verses.roman:
brahmaivedamamṛtaṃ purastād brahma paścād brahma dakṣiṇataścottareṇa .
adhaścordhvaṃ ca prasṛtaṃ brahmaivedaṃ viśvamidaṃ variṣṭham .. 11..
.. iti muṇḍakopaniṣadi dvitīyamuṇḍake dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ..
verses.colloquial:
brahmaivedamamritam purastaad brahma pashchaad brahma dakshinatashchottarena .
adhashchordhvam cha prasritam brahmaivedam vishvamidam varishtham .. 11..
.. iti mundakopanishadi dvitiiyamundake dvitiiyah khandah ..
verses.translation_reworded: That immortal Brahman alone is in front, that Brahman is behind, that Brahman is to the right and to the left. Brahman alone pervades everything above and below. This universe is that Supreme Brahman alone.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वा सुपर्णा सयुजा सखाया समानं वृक्षं परिषस्वजाते ।
तयोरन्यः पिप्पलं स्वाद्वत्त्यनश्नन्नन्यो अभिचाकशीति ॥ १॥
verses.roman:
dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte .
tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo abhicākaśīti .. 1..
verses.colloquial:
dvaa suparnaa sayujaa sakhaayaa samaanam vriksham parishasvajaate .
tayoranyah pippalam svaadvattyanashnannanyo abhichaakashiiti .. 1..
verses.translation_reworded: Two birds, always together and known by the same name, cling closely to one tree. One of them eats the sweet fruit; the other watches and does not eat.

verses.sanskrit:
समाने वृक्षे पुरुषो निमग्नोऽनिशया शोचति मुह्यमानः ।
जुष्टं यदा पश्यत्यन्यमीशमस्य
महिमानमिति वीतशोकः ॥ २॥
verses.roman:
samāne vṛkṣe puruṣo nimagno'niśayā śocati muhyamānaḥ .
juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśamasya
mahimānamiti vītaśokaḥ .. 2..
verses.colloquial:
samaane vrikshe purusho nimagno'nishayaa shochati muhyamaanah .
jushtam yadaa pashyatyanyamiishamasya
mahimaanamiti viitashokah .. 2..
verses.translation_reworded: Sitting on that same tree, the jiva moans, bewildered by his powerlessness. But when he sees the other, the Lord whom all worship, and His glory, he is freed from grief.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा पश्यः पश्यते रुक्मवर्णं
कर्तारमीशं पुरुषं ब्रह्मयोनिम् ।
तदा विद्वान् पुण्यपापे विधूय
निरञ्जनः परमं साम्यमुपैति ॥ ३॥
verses.roman:
yadā paśyaḥ paśyate rukmavarṇaṃ
kartāramīśaṃ puruṣaṃ brahmayonim .
tadā vidvān puṇyapāpe vidhūya
nirañjanaḥ paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti .. 3..
verses.colloquial:
yadaa pashyah pashyate rukmavarnam
kartaaramiisham purusham brahmayonim .
tadaa vidvaan punyapaape vidhuuya
niranjanah paramam saamyamupaiti .. 3..
verses.translation_reworded: When the seer sees the self-luminous Creator, the Lord, the Purusha, the progenitor of Brahma, then that wise seer shakes off good and evil, becomes stainless, and reaches the supreme unity.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रणो ह्येष यः सर्वभूतैर्विभाति
विजानन् विद्वान् भवते नातिवादी ।
आत्मक्रीड आत्मरतिः क्रियावा-
नेष ब्रह्मविदां वरिष्ठः ॥ ४॥
verses.roman:
praṇo hyeṣa yaḥ sarvabhūtairvibhāti
vijānan vidvān bhavate nātivādī .
ātmakrīḍa ātmaratiḥ kriyāvā-
neṣa brahmavidāṃ variṣṭhaḥ .. 4..
verses.colloquial:
prano hyesha yah sarvabhuutairvibhaati
vijaanan vidvaan bhavate naativaadii .
aatmakriida aatmaratih kriyaavaa-
nesha brahmavidaam varishthah .. 4..
verses.translation_reworded: He is indeed Prana, shining forth in many ways in all beings. The wise person who knows Him does not babble. Revelling in the Self, delighting in the Self, and performing actions, such a person is foremost among the knowers of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्येन लभ्यस्तपसा ह्येष आत्मा
सम्यग्ज्ञानेन ब्रह्मचर्येण नित्यम् ।
अन्तःशरीरे ज्योतिर्मयो हि शुभ्रो
यं पश्यन्ति यतयः क्षीणदोषाः ॥ ५॥
verses.roman:
satyena labhyastapasā hyeṣa ātmā
samyagjñānena brahmacaryeṇa nityam .
antaḥśarīre jyotirmayo hi śubhro
yaṃ paśyanti yatayaḥ kṣīṇadoṣāḥ .. 5..
verses.colloquial:
satyena labhyastapasaa hyesha aatmaa
samyagjnaanena brahmacharyena nityam .
antahshariire jyotirmayo hi shubhro
yam pashyanti yatayah kshiinadoshaah .. 5..
verses.translation_reworded: This Atman, radiant and pure, whom sinless sannyasins see living within the body, is reached by the unceasing practice of truthfulness, austerity, right knowledge, and continence.

verses.sanskrit:
सत्यमेव जयते नानृतं
सत्येन पन्था विततो देवयानः ।
येनाऽऽक्रमन्त्यृषयो ह्याप्तकामा
यत्र तत् सत्यस्य परमं निधानम् ॥ ६॥
verses.roman:
satyameva jayate nānṛtaṃ
satyena panthā vitato devayānaḥ .
yenā''kramantyṛṣayo hyāptakāmā
yatra tat satyasya paramaṃ nidhānam .. 6..
verses.colloquial:
satyameva jayate naanritam
satyena panthaa vitato devayaanah .
yenaa''kramantyrishayo hyaaptakaamaa
yatra tat satyasya paramam nidhaanam .. 6..
verses.translation_reworded: Truth alone prevails, not falsehood. Truth lays out the path, the Way of the Gods, along which the seers, every desire fulfilled, travel to the Highest Abode of the True.

verses.sanskrit:
बृहच्च तद् दिव्यमचिन्त्यरूपं
सूक्ष्माच्च तत् सूक्ष्मतरं विभाति ।
दूरात् सुदूरे तदिहान्तिके च
पश्यन्त्विहैव निहितं गुहायाम् ॥ ७॥
verses.roman:
bṛhacca tad divyamacintyarūpaṃ
sūkṣmācca tat sūkṣmataraṃ vibhāti .
dūrāt sudūre tadihāntike ca
paśyantvihaiva nihitaṃ guhāyām .. 7..
verses.colloquial:
brihaccha tad divyamachintyaruupam
suukshmaaccha tat suukshmataram vibhaati .
duuraat suduure tadihaantike cha
pashyantvihaiva nihitam guhaayaam .. 7..
verses.translation_reworded: That Brahman shines forth, vast, self-luminous, beyond conception, subtler than the subtle. He is farther than what is far, and yet very near at hand here. Truly, He is seen here, living in the cave of the heart of conscious beings.

verses.sanskrit:
न चक्षुषा गृह्यते नापि वाचा
नान्यैर्देवैस्तपसा कर्मण वा ।
ज्ञानप्रसादेन विशुद्धसत्त्व-
स्ततस्तु तं पश्यते निष्कलं
ध्यायमानः ॥ ८॥
verses.roman:
na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate nāpi vācā
nānyairdevaistapasā karmaṇa vā .
jñānaprasādena viśuddhasattva-
statastu taṃ paśyate niṣkalaṃ
dhyāyamānaḥ .. 8..
verses.colloquial:
na chakshushaa grihyate naapi vaachaa
naanyairdevaistapasaa karmana vaa .
jnaanaprasaadena vishuddhasattva-
statastu tam pashyate nishkalam
dhyaayamaanah .. 8..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman cannot be grasped by the eye, by speech, or by the other senses, nor by penance or good works. One becomes pure through serenity of intellect, and then, in meditation, sees Him who has no parts.

verses.sanskrit:
एषोऽणुरात्मा चेतसा वेदितव्यो
यस्मिन् प्राणः पञ्चधा संविवेश ।
प्राणैश्चित्तं सर्वमोतं प्रजानां
यस्मिन् विशुद्धे विभवत्येष आत्मा ॥ ९॥
verses.roman:
eṣo'ṇurātmā cetasā veditavyo
yasmin prāṇaḥ pañcadhā saṃviveśa .
prāṇaiścittaṃ sarvamotaṃ prajānāṃ
yasmin viśuddhe vibhavatyeṣa ātmā .. 9..
verses.colloquial:
esho'nuraatmaa chetasaa veditavyo
yasmin praanah panchadhaa samvivesha .
praanaishchittam sarvamotam prajaanaam
yasmin vishuddhe vibhavatyesha aatmaa .. 9..
verses.translation_reworded: That subtle Atman must be known by the intellect here in the body, where the prana has entered in five forms. Atman pervades human intellects along with the senses. When the intellect is purified, Atman shines forth.

verses.sanskrit:
यं यं लोकं मनसा संविभाति
विशुद्धसत्त्वः कामयते यांश्च कामान् ।
तं तं लोकं जयते तांश्च कामां-
स्तस्मादात्मज्ञं ह्यर्चयेत् भूतिकामः ॥ १०॥
॥ इति मुण्डकोपनिषदि तृतीयमुण्डके प्रथमः खण्डः ॥
verses.roman:
yaṃ yaṃ lokaṃ manasā saṃvibhāti
viśuddhasattvaḥ kāmayate yāṃśca kāmān .
taṃ taṃ lokaṃ jayate tāṃśca kāmāṃ-
stasmādātmajñaṃ hyarcayet bhūtikāmaḥ .. 10..
.. iti muṇḍakopaniṣadi tṛtīyamuṇḍake prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ..
verses.colloquial:
yam yam lokam manasaa samvibhaati
vishuddhasattvah kaamayate yaamshcha kaamaan .
tam tam lokam jayate taamshcha kaamaam-
stasmaadaatmajnam hyarchayet bhuutikaamah .. 10..
.. iti mundakopanishadi tritiiyamundake prathamah khandah ..
verses.translation_reworded: Whatever world a person of pure understanding pictures in his mind, and whatever desires he holds, that world he conquers and those desires he gains. So let everyone who wants prosperity worship the one who knows the Self.

verses.sanskrit:
स वेदैतत् परमं ब्रह्म धाम
यत्र विश्वं निहितं भाति शुभ्रम् ।
उपासते पुरुषं ये ह्यकामास्ते
शुक्रमेतदतिवर्तन्ति धीराः ॥ १॥
verses.roman:
sa vedaitat paramaṃ brahma dhāma
yatra viśvaṃ nihitaṃ bhāti śubhram .
upāsate puruṣaṃ ye hyakāmāste
śukrametadativartanti dhīrāḥ .. 1..
verses.colloquial:
sa vedaitat paramam brahma dhaama
yatra vishvam nihitam bhaati shubhram .
upaasate purusham ye hyakaamaaste
shukrametadativartanti dhiiraah .. 1..
verses.translation_reworded: The Knower of the Self knows that Supreme Abode of Brahman, brightly shining, in which the universe rests. Those wise people who, free of desires, worship such a person pass beyond the seed of birth.

verses.sanskrit:
कामान् यः कामयते मन्यमानः
स कामभिर्जायते तत्र तत्र ।
पर्याप्तकामस्य कृतात्मनस्तु
इहैव सर्वे प्रविलीयन्ति कामाः ॥ २॥
verses.roman:
kāmān yaḥ kāmayate manyamānaḥ
sa kāmabhirjāyate tatra tatra .
paryāptakāmasya kṛtātmanastu
ihaiva sarve pravilīyanti kāmāḥ .. 2..
verses.colloquial:
kaamaan yah kaamayate manyamaanah
sa kaamabhirjaayate tatra tatra .
paryaaptakaamasya kritaatmanastu
ihaiva sarve praviliiyanti kaamaah .. 2..
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever cherishes objects and longs for them is born again here or there because of those desires. But for one whose desires are satisfied and who is established in the Self, all desires vanish even here on earth.

verses.sanskrit:
नायमात्मा प्रवचनेन लभ्यो
न मेधया न बहुना श्रुतेन ।
यमेवैष वृणुते तेन लभ्य-
स्तस्यैष आत्मा विवृणुते तनूं स्वाम् ॥ ३॥
verses.roman:
nāyamātmā pravacanena labhyo
na medhayā na bahunā śrutena .
yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhya-
stasyaiṣa ātmā vivṛṇute tanūṃ svām .. 3..
verses.colloquial:
naayamaatmaa pravachanena labhyo
na medhayaa na bahunaa shrutena .
yamevaisha vrinute tena labhya-
stasyaisha aatmaa vivrinute tanuum svaam .. 3..
verses.translation_reworded: This Atman cannot be reached through study of the Vedas, through intelligence, or through much learning. It is reached only by the one who chooses Atman. It is Atman that reveals Its true nature to the seeker.

verses.sanskrit:
नायमात्मा बलहीनेन लभ्यो
न च प्रमादात् तपसो वाप्यलिङ्गात् ।
एतैरुपायैर्यतते यस्तु विद्वां-
स्तस्यैष आत्मा विशते ब्रह्मधाम ॥ ४॥
verses.roman:
nāyamātmā balahīnena labhyo
na ca pramādāt tapaso vāpyaliṅgāt .
etairupāyairyatate yastu vidvāṃ-
stasyaiṣa ātmā viśate brahmadhāma .. 4..
verses.colloquial:
naayamaatmaa balahiinena labhyo
na cha pramaadaat tapaso vaapyalingaat .
etairupaayairyatate yastu vidvaam-
stasyaisha aatmaa vishate brahmadhaama .. 4..
verses.translation_reworded: This Atman cannot be reached by anyone lacking strength or earnestness, or lacking knowledge joined with renunciation. But if a wise person strives with these aids, his soul enters the Abode of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
सम्प्राप्यैनमृषयो ज्ञानतृप्ताः
कृतात्मानो वीतरागाः प्रशान्ताः
ते सर्वगं सर्वतः प्राप्य धीरा
युक्तात्मानः सर्वमेवाविशन्ति ॥ ५॥
verses.roman:
samprāpyainamṛṣayo jñānatṛptāḥ
kṛtātmāno vītarāgāḥ praśāntāḥ
te sarvagaṃ sarvataḥ prāpya dhīrā
yuktātmānaḥ sarvamevāviśanti .. 5..
verses.colloquial:
sampraapyainamrishayo jnaanatriptaah
kritaatmaano viitaraagaah prashaantaah
te sarvagam sarvatah praapya dhiiraa
yuktaatmaanah sarvamevaavishanti .. 5..
verses.translation_reworded: Having realized Atman, the seers are satisfied with that Knowledge. Their souls rest in the Supreme Self; they are free of passions and tranquil in mind. These calm souls, always devoted to the Self, see the omnipresent Brahman everywhere and in the end enter into It, which is all this.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदान्तविज्ञानसुनिश्चितार्थाः
संन्यासयोगाद् यतयः शुद्धसत्त्वाः ।
ते ब्रह्मलोकेषु परान्तकाले
परामृताः परिमुच्यन्ति सर्वे ॥ ६॥
verses.roman:
vedāntavijñānasuniścitārthāḥ
saṃnyāsayogād yatayaḥ śuddhasattvāḥ .
te brahmalokeṣu parāntakāle
parāmṛtāḥ parimucyanti sarve .. 6..
verses.colloquial:
vedaantavijnaanasunishchitaarthaah
samnyaasayogaad yatayah shuddhasattvaah .
te brahmalokeshu paraantakaale
paraamritaah parimuchyanti sarve .. 6..
verses.translation_reworded: The seers have clearly established the Self, the goal of Vedantic knowledge, and have purified their minds through the practice of sannyasa. Never slackening their efforts, they enjoy supreme Immortality here, and at the time of the great end they gain complete freedom in Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
गताः कलाः पञ्चदश प्रतिष्ठा
देवाश्च सर्वे प्रतिदेवतासु ।
कर्माणि विज्ञानमयश्च आत्मा
परेऽव्यये सर्वे एकीभवन्ति ॥ ७॥
verses.roman:
gatāḥ kalāḥ pañcadaśa pratiṣṭhā
devāśca sarve pratidevatāsu .
karmāṇi vijñānamayaśca ātmā
pare'vyaye sarve ekībhavanti .. 7..
verses.colloquial:
gataah kalaah panchadasha pratishthaa
devaashcha sarve pratidevataasu .
karmaani vijnaanamayashcha aatmaa
pare'vyaye sarve ekiibhavanti .. 7..
verses.translation_reworded: The fifteen parts return to their causes and all the senses to their deities. The actions and the Atman reflected in the buddhi become one with the highest imperishable Brahman, the Self of all.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा नद्यः स्यन्दमानाः समुद्रेऽ
स्तं गच्छन्ति नामरूपे विहाय ।
तथा विद्वान् नामरूपाद्विमुक्तः
परात्परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ॥ ८॥
verses.roman:
yathā nadyaḥ syandamānāḥ samudre'
staṃ gacchanti nāmarūpe vihāya .
tathā vidvān nāmarūpādvimuktaḥ
parātparaṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam .. 8..
verses.colloquial:
yathaa nadyah syandamaanaah samudre'
stam gacchanti naamaruupe vihaaya .
tathaa vidvaan naamaruupaadvimuktah
paraatparam purushamupaiti divyam .. 8..
verses.translation_reworded: As flowing rivers vanish into the sea and lose their names and forms, so a wise person, released from name and form, reaches the Purusha, who is greater than the Great.

verses.sanskrit:
स यो ह वै तत् परमं ब्रह्म वेद
ब्रह्मैव भवति नास्याब्रह्मवित्कुले भवति ।
तरति शोकं तरति पाप्मानं गुहाग्रन्थिभ्यो
विमुक्तोऽमृतो भवति ॥ ९॥
verses.roman:
sa yo ha vai tat paramaṃ brahma veda
brahmaiva bhavati nāsyābrahmavitkule bhavati .
tarati śokaṃ tarati pāpmānaṃ guhāgranthibhyo
vimukto'mṛto bhavati .. 9..
verses.colloquial:
sa yo ha vai tat paramam brahma veda
brahmaiva bhavati naasyaabrahmavitkule bhavati .
tarati shokam tarati paapmaanam guhaagranthibhyo
vimukto'mrito bhavati .. 9..
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever knows the Supreme Brahman truly becomes Brahman. No one ignorant of Brahman is born in that person's family. Such a person overcomes grief, overcomes evil, and, freed from the fetters of the heart, becomes immortal.

verses.sanskrit:
तदेतदृचाऽभ्युक्तम् ।
क्रियावन्तः श्रोत्रिया ब्रह्मनिष्ठाः
स्वयं जुह्वत एकर्षिं श्रद्धयन्तः ।
तेषामेवैतां ब्रह्मविद्यां वदेत
शिरोव्रतं विधिवद् यैस्तु चीर्णम् ॥ १०॥
verses.roman:
tadetadṛcā'bhyuktam .
kriyāvantaḥ śrotriyā brahmaniṣṭhāḥ
svayaṃ juhvata ekarṣiṃ śraddhayantaḥ .
teṣāmevaitāṃ brahmavidyāṃ vadeta
śirovrataṃ vidhivad yaistu cīrṇam .. 10..
verses.colloquial:
tadetadrichaa'bhyuktam .
kriyaavantah shrotriyaa brahmanishthaah
svayam juhvata ekarshim shraddhayantah .
teshaamevaitaam brahmavidyaam vadeta
shirovratam vidhivad yaistu chiirnam .. 10..
verses.translation_reworded: A Rik-verse declares: Tell this Knowledge of Brahman only to those who have done the necessary duties, who are versed in the Vedas and devoted to Brahman, and who, full of faith, have offered oblations in the Ekarshi Fire and carried out, according to rule, the rite of carrying fire on the head.
